facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: near hit during a breakdown response on LA-7202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on LA-7202 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. LA-7202 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 8 November 2009 a near hit was recorded on LA-7202 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a breakdown response; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
